title: Scalar compatibility of the specified local cohomology-to-stalk class map
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $p\in\mathbb N$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, $c:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$, $X′=\operatorname{Spec}A\times_Y X$, $f′:X′\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $g′:X′\to X$ the projections, and $F′=g′^*F$. Let $b:H^p(X′,F′)\to(c_*R^pf′_*F′)_y$ be the specified additive map [def-weil-pbc-local-direct-image-stalk-class-map], with $A$ acting on its source through Gamma-Spec followed by $f′.\mathrm{appTop}$. For every $r\in A$ and $x\in H^p(X′,F′)$, $b(r\cdot x)=r\cdot b(x)$. No invertibility assertion is made.

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3, the comparison of section-complex cohomology with higher direct-image sheaves; Tag 02OD, Lemma 30.20.7, the displayed local-stalk/global-cohomology equality, before formal functions. Scalar compatibility expanded by S4.

proof.text: Put F′ equal to the tensor pullback, K equal to its specified injective resolution, h equal to the first projection, and t = Gamma-Spec.inv(r). Unfold the actual additive localDirectImage_stalk_class map. The restricted-scalar action on its domain is h.appTop(t) acting on ordinary module cohomology. Its remaining composite is resolutionSectionClass at top, the inverse right-derived pushforward resolution comparison on top, and the germ.

Prove the private helper resolution_top_smul for an arbitrary scheme morphism and injective resolution. Let A be the global-section module complex and B the underlying presheaf-module complex of the direct image. The two underlying top-section additive short complexes are definitionally equal. Scalar multiplication by h.appTop(t) on A is equal degreewise to the natural transformation multiplying evaluation at top of B by t. Apply ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans (the exact-functor comparison) to this equality. Conjugate the resulting equality by the inverse forgetful mapHomologyIso and the evaluation mapHomologyIso; cancel the inverse pairs. This proves semilinearity of their composite on homology. Compose with the linear isoRightDerivedObj.hom and the linear top component of sectionCohomologyTheta. The intervening homology of the identity section-complex map is identity. This proves scalar compatibility of resolutionSectionClass on top without any new unfinished statement.

Prove the private helper local_germ_smul for any module G on Spec(O_{Y,y}). Represent r by a structure-sheaf section a on V containing y. Scheme.fromSpecStalk_app identifies c.app(V)(a) with the restriction of Gamma-Spec.inv(r) to c inverse V. Rewrite the two top germs as germs of their restrictions to V using germ_res_apply. The restriction map of G respects scalar multiplication, and the preceding ring identity identifies its scalar with c.app(V)(a). The pushforward module action and PresheafOfModules.germ_smul give r times the original germ. No identification of the inverse-image open with top is required. Finally apply resolution_top_smul, linearity of the inverse pushforward resolution comparison on top (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul), and local_germ_smul. All statements remain unchanged, including degree zero, the zero module and empty base change.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 20.7.3 (Tag 01E4), section-complex comparison; Lemma 30.20.7 (Tag 02OD), local cohomology/stalk equality. A3 formalized scalar compatibility using homologyMap_mapNatTrans and fromSpecStalk_app.

from.place: Scalar compatibility of the local-stalk/global-cohomology equality used before formal functions; the third step of the local class equivalence argument.

lean.statement:
theorem localDirectImage_stalk_class_smul {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Y.presheaf.stalk y)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
          (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) :
    localDirectImage_stalk_class f y F p (r • x) =
      r • localDirectImage_stalk_class f y F p x
